clips.title: The story
paras: At Silverpine’s southern edge, Greymane Wall bars the way into Gilneas. King Genn Greymane raised the stone barrier after the Second War, and its gates remain locked against the outside world.

King Genn Greymane turned from the Alliance after the Second War, resentful of its demands, especially the taxes for the orc internment camps. He believed Gilneas had paid enough in coin and blood for troubles beyond its borders. Greymane withdrew the kingdom from the Alliance and ordered a vast barrier built across the head of the peninsula. When the Third War brought the Plague of Undeath and desperate refugees to the wall, its gates stayed shut.
